description: JRC-EU-TIMES - JRC TIMES energy system model for the EU is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Wouter Nijs (European Commission Joint Research Centre). JRC-EU-TIMES is designed for analysing the role of energy technologies and their innovation for meeting Europe's energy and climate change related policy objectives. This database contains a synchronised model version of the full JRC-EU-TIMES.and all input Excel files for the JRC-EU-TIMES model, owned by JRC. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
